name: Groups
overview: Scripture highlights the vital role of groups, especially small gatherings, in the spiritual growth and fellowship of believers. Proverbs 27:17 illustrates how mutual encouragement sharpens and strengthens relationships, while Matthew 18:19-20 affirms the power and presence of Christ when believers unite in His name. The early church's devotion to teaching, fellowship, breaking bread, and prayer (Acts 2:42) models the importance of consistent communal engagement, which fosters faith as it grows through hearing God's Word (Romans 10:17). Together, these passages underscore that Christian life flourishes in the context of committed, Spirit-centered groups.
